description: Expander for slips, placed immediately to its right, whose twelve note buttons set a custom scale for slips to quantize to

params.text: Puts that note into the custom scale while it is lit

notes: with no note lit, slips quantizes to the scale picked by its own scale knob.
the lamp at the bottom of the panel lights while the module is next to a slips on its left, which is the only position in which the note buttons reach anything.
